title: Understanding Psychology (Student Edition)

sources.what: publisher program overview for the 2014 edition, with table of contents
publisher table of contents (later marketing code SS18; same 21 chapters)

summary: An introductory high-school psychology text written to the APA national standards, running from the history and methods of psychology through development across the lifespan, biology and consciousness, learning, memory, and cognition, to personality, disorders and therapy, and social psychology. It is built on Understanding by Design with essential questions, case studies, and hands-on labs.

toc.label: Chapter 1
toc.title: Approaches to Psychology
toc.covers: What psychology is, its history from Wundt and James onward, and the major perspectives and careers in the field.

toc.label: Chapter 2
toc.title: Psychological Research Methods and Statistics
toc.covers: Surveys, case studies, experiments, correlation, research ethics, and descriptive and inferential statistics.

toc.label: Chapter 3
toc.title: Infancy and Childhood
toc.covers: Physical, cognitive (Piaget), emotional, and social development from birth through childhood, including attachment and parenting.

toc.label: Chapter 4
toc.title: Adolescence
toc.covers: Puberty, cognitive and moral development (Kohlberg), identity (Erikson), and peer and family relationships.

toc.label: Chapter 5
toc.title: Adulthood and Old Age
toc.covers: Adult development, careers and families, aging, and death and dying.

toc.label: Chapter 6
toc.title: Body and Behavior
toc.covers: Neurons, the nervous system, brain structure and study methods, the endocrine system, and heredity and environment.

toc.label: Chapter 7
toc.title: Altered States of Consciousness
toc.covers: Sleep and dreams, hypnosis, biofeedback, meditation, and psychoactive drugs.

toc.label: Chapter 8
toc.title: Sensation and Perception
toc.covers: The senses (vision, hearing, touch, taste, smell, balance), thresholds, and perceptual organisation and illusions.

toc.label: Chapter 9
toc.title: Learning: Principles and Applications
toc.covers: Classical and operant conditioning, reinforcement schedules, social and cognitive learning, and behaviour modification.

toc.label: Chapter 10
toc.title: Memory and Thought
toc.covers: Encoding, storage, and retrieval, short- and long-term memory, and forgetting.

toc.label: Chapter 11
toc.title: Thinking and Language
toc.covers: Concepts, problem solving, decision making, creativity, and language acquisition.

toc.label: Chapter 12
toc.title: Motivation and Emotion
toc.covers: Theories of motivation, hunger and other drives, and theories and expression of emotion.

toc.label: Chapter 13
toc.title: Psychological Testing
toc.covers: Test reliability and validity, intelligence and IQ testing, and aptitude, achievement, interest, and personality tests.

toc.label: Chapter 14
toc.title: Theories of Personality
toc.covers: Psychoanalytic, trait, humanistic, social-cognitive, and behavioural theories of personality.

toc.label: Chapter 15
toc.title: Stress and Health
toc.covers: Sources and effects of stress, coping strategies, and health psychology.

toc.label: Chapter 16
toc.title: Psychological Disorders
toc.covers: Defining abnormality, DSM classification, and anxiety, mood, schizophrenic, personality, and substance-related disorders.

toc.label: Chapter 17
toc.title: Therapy and Change
toc.covers: Psychotherapy approaches (psychoanalytic, humanistic, cognitive, behavioural) and biological treatments.

toc.label: Chapter 18
toc.title: Individual Interaction
toc.covers: Interpersonal attraction, friendship and love, and social perception and attribution.

toc.label: Chapter 19
toc.title: Group Interaction
toc.covers: Group structure and dynamics, conformity, obedience (Milgram), and leadership.

toc.label: Chapter 20
toc.title: Attitudes and Social Influence
toc.covers: How attitudes form and change, prejudice, persuasion, and cognitive dissonance.

toc.label: Chapter 21
toc.title: Psychology: Present and Future
toc.covers: Applied fields of psychology and emerging areas of research.

notes: Chapter titles are from the publisher's TOC; both fetched documents list the same 21 chapters. Any unit groupings and the section titles were not found. Which DSM edition Chapter 16 follows was not checked (DSM-5 came out in 2013, the year before this edition). Chapters 15-17 deal with stress and mental health and may need care with students.
